hold_pairing: Consecutive hold_start/hold_end in incident order; intervals [start,end); zero duration allowed; no nesting.
invalid_event_policy: Quarantine entire incident history; report every raw record disposition separately.
late_event_policy: Source/event time determines eligibility, batch delivery time does not.
precision: Compare unrounded seconds; expose minutes/rates rounded to 6 decimals.
response_event: response with actor_id in users; unknown actor does not stop first-response clock

rules.BR-001: Normalize whitespace, status variants, priority numbers, timezone offsets. Invalid values quarantine the entire incident history.
rules.BR-002: Identical same-key versions/events deduplicate; conflicting identities quarantine all records for affected incidents. Latest snapshot selected by (source_updated_at, source_version) <= cutoff.
rules.BR-003: Required service/group must exist in every eligible snapshot. Optional missing users become unknown_user. Reference keys are unique.
rules.BR-004: Initial state new. Sort events by (event_time, source_sequence); ambiguous order quarantines incident. Snapshot status must match event state at its source_updated_at. Future records deferred.
rules.BR-005: Response clock never pauses; known actor required for response. Resolution clock subtracts hold intervals across all reopen cycles. Unmatched hold starts end at cutoff only while on_hold. Reject overlap, unmatched end, and transitions from on_hold without hold_end.
rules.BR-006: Creation-time priority selects versioned targets; equality passes. Open resolution clock ends at cutoff. Pending only while elapsed <= target. Reopened incidents have no final resolved_at until re-resolved.
rules.BR-007: Sparse daily UTC rows; cutoff inclusive for source eligibility, day ends exclusive. Creation uses creation dimensions; final resolution uses dimensions at resolution; backlog uses dimensions and state immediately before next midnight. SLA metrics reflect final resolutions only.
rules.BR-008: Delta manifests identify exact parent. Local implementation replays all committed raw batches and fully rebuilds; partition-targeted optimization is deferred. Reassigned/date-corrected histories replace old Gold rows atomically.
